body:
Akineton Takes Over
I have several mental health condition one of them is Insomnia. I wasn't able to sleep straight for 3 days. And when it was day 4 I was feel like dying. My medications are benzodiazepines and seroquel with an antidepressant. They were not helping me to sleep at all lately.
My medications are benzodiazepines and seroquel with an antidepressant. They were not helping me to sleep at all lately.
The meds I got from my doc. Didn't work since I had cirrhosis she couldn't give me anything stronger than mirtazapine. I couldn't stand being not able to sleep I couldn't even eat. Even if I sleep I would wake up in 30 minutes. So I went to a different hospital and told them the situation but didn't mention about the cirrhosis. They offered me some Haloperidol, Valium, Seroquel, but I refused since none of those would work. Instead they were ok with giving me 5x Injection of Akineton which contains a total amount of 25 MG Biperiden.
So doc. said I'll give injection for
Akineton but we will put in your serum. I told him if they can just make the shot on my butt. He replied I guess you never had that much akineton before and laughed. I'm experienced with opioids, psych. medication and tranquilizers. So I thought it wasn't gonna work. My father who brought me to the hospital went home and said call me when you are done and I'll pick you up with a car he thought that I'll lose my shit but I said I'll be fine I can go back to home by myself. He said anyway I'll be there in an hour or so.
I had 20 mg of diazepam in the last 10 hours.
T:0.00 They put me in a wheeled bed and gave me some supportive stuff because I was weak.
T:0.05 Nurse came in to do injection. I told them that I want injection on the hip and want to fall asleep at home. She kindly rejected that and told me to relax. And mixed the shots in the vitamin serum.
T:0.40 I wasn't really feeling anything besides my arm hurt so much from the medicine. And called out for nurse told her that I wasn't feeling sleepy at all. And she increased the flow rate of the serum to maximum.
T:0.55 This is where things started to become interesting. I was listening to some music with my headphones but I suddenly started to feel a discomfort in my chest and legs. I called nurse again told her that I was feeling a bit weird. She slowed down the serum and left.
T:1.15 Serum was halfway there and I had that feeling that I was going to be fucked so I called my father to pick me up.
T:1.25 My father came but I had to stay for 40 minutes more to finish the serum. And my father left to have some coffee till I finish.
T:1.35 I started to have some vivid visual hallucinations on the white curtains around the bed it was cartoonish but I could watch it if it was projected on the curtains. And I said yea that works too. I forgot my insomnia for awhile because I was lightheaded and felt like sobering up from a hardcore drinking night.
T:1.45 My mouth is so dry I constantly try to swallow but I can't. I no longer feel my body it's completely numb and my vision is blurry. I started to lose myself and had severe audio hallucinations. I heard a friend of mine who is livin far far away and I thought he was sitting next to me and I was having a conversation while there is no one.
T:1.50 I've came to my senses and I was like "who the hell I'm talking to". Then a few minutes later it happened again.
(After that point I blacked out completely don't have a clue at all about what happened it was around 9 pm and I woke up at 8 am and I thought I just fell asleep but listen what happened according to my father.)
T:2.00 Only my father was around that night and he said he picked me up 15 minutes later after he went to get some coffee. I just couldn't believe how messed up my awareness is I couldn't even tell how long it has been. And he tried to take me home I recall that I was trying to wear my shoes but thats all of it. My old man said that I wasn't able to wear my shoes so he helped me with that. I even couldn't get out of the bed and sit on wheelchair to the car.
T:2.05 In the car he said that I was talking nonsense. I was pointing to the wheels and asking him which butcher he get those wheels from?
T:2.15 We were home I went to bed but I was up in minutes again and walking around the house.
T:2.30 I guess I took a bottle of windex and offered it to my dad as a beer. My exact sentence was this "Welcome to our pub sir, would you like to have some beer." And he said I sprayed it around.
T:2.35 There is a small thing I can remember, but I'm sure. My mouth couldn't produce saliva. I was feeling like cotton mouth but not like cannabis dry mouth. It was dry completely and I was chewing the cud like a cow. I only remember this but it felt like hell.
T:3.00 My father told me that I was talking gibberish for 20 minutes. I was talking making sounds but I wasn't able to communicate and what I say was not a language. I don't know how it did sound. I asked him why you didn't record this, he said I didn't think of that I was having fun. After all these funny high stuff I slept for 8-9 hours and woke up and had some cereal then slept again for 2 hr more.
When I woke up I didn't have any serious side effects just some drowsiness.
After I woke up completely I felt a lil bit of headache and mind fog. After effects wasn't that bad I could drive a car or work without any annoyance. But I didn't find this medicine recreational at all since I didn't remember anything of what I said and what I did.
On the next day I went to see my psychiatrist and told her what happened exactly. She asked for the name of the hospital and repeated 3 times are you sure of that they gave you that much Akineton. I was like yeah, I'm good with pharmacology btw but my roads never crossed with biperiden until then. So after I came back to home researched for the side effects and overdose.
I was more than lucky to be alive. There is something wrong with that hospital I know that. The doctor on duty in the nights always the same and smoking right outside the door. Whenever I rush there with a panic attack or something he always sends me home high but this time was too much. I'm thankful to have a experience like this but I wish I was able to control it.
I wasn't even able to understand what was going on I wasn't even able to tell if I was gone when I called the nurse for the first time or not. I'm not even sure that I called her.
It has been 2 months I guess and I'm struggling so much with my memory. I used to have a great memory I could remember my address from 20 years ago but now I forget things I say easily. There times that I get confused so much and I hesitated that if we were in 2020 or 2022 when filling up a form at work. Prob. gonna get an MRi scan to see if something is wrong since I can't prove it to my therapist and psychiatrist. It's OD effects are way more worse than any kind of opioid.
